def test_carts_patch_item():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    sock = resp.json()[0]
    sock_id = sock["id"]
    sock_price = sock["price"]

    item_data = {
        "itemId": sock_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": sock_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    patch_data = {
        "itemId": sock_id,
        "quantity": 10
    }
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=patch_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    item_resp = resp.json()
    assert item_resp["quantity"] == 10
    assert item_resp["itemId"] == sock_id

    item_resp = resp.json()

    assert resp_get.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_get.status_code}: {resp_get.text}"

    resp2 = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp2.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp2.status_code}: {resp2.text}"
